data.name: Eagles of World War 2
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Storm of Steel

The skies are filled with enemy fighters, relentless attacks, and impossible odds.

Only the most skilled pilots will survive.

Eagles Of World War 2 is a fast-paced bullet hell shooter inspired by World War II, combining intense aerial combat, powerful upgrades, bullet time mechanics, and score-chasing arcade action.

Dodge overwhelming waves of enemy fire, destroy enemy squadrons, collect powerful upgrades, and push your skills to the limit as you battle through increasingly dangerous missions.

Can you survive the chaos and become a legendary ace?

Master Bullet Time

When the skies become overwhelming, every second matters.

Activate bullet time to slow the action, weave through deadly bullet patterns, and find the perfect opportunity to strike back.

Use this powerful ability strategically to survive impossible situations and turn the tide of battle.

Mastering bullet time is the key to becoming a true ace pilot.

Dodge Impossible Bullet Patterns

Enemy aircraft fill the skies with relentless attacks.

Navigate through dense bullet formations, react to constantly changing threats, and survive increasingly challenging encounters.

Every mission will test your reflexes, precision, and ability to stay calm under pressure.

One mistake can mean disaster.

Upgrade Your Fighter

Earn rewards and strengthen your aircraft between missions.

Improve your fighter's capabilities, increase your combat effectiveness, and prepare for even greater challenges ahead.

Choose upgrades that match your playstyle and build the ultimate war machine.

The stronger your aircraft becomes, the deeper you can push into enemy territory.

Play Solo or Team Up

Take on the challenge alone or join forces with a friend.

Work together in local co-op or use Remote Play Together to battle through the campaign as a team.

Coordinate your attacks, survive overwhelming enemy forces, and achieve scores that would be impossible alone.

Compete for Global Glory

Victory is only the beginning.

Fight for higher scores, complete missions more efficiently, and prove your skills against players from around the world.

Climb the global leaderboards and earn your place among the greatest pilots.

Only the best will reach the top.

Fast-Paced Arcade Action

Eagles Of World War 2 combines the accessibility of classic arcade shooters with the challenge and intensity of modern bullet hell gameplay.

Easy to learn but difficult to master, every mission offers another opportunity to improve your skills and chase a higher score.

Whether you're a veteran shoot-'em-up player or new to the genre, the skies are waiting.

Features

  • Intense WWII-inspired bullet hell combat

  • Unique bullet time mechanic

  • Permanent aircraft upgrade system

  • Challenging enemy formations and encounters

  • Solo and local co-op gameplay

  • Remote Play Together support

  • Global online leaderboards

  • Multiple difficulty settings

  • Fast-paced arcade shooter action

  • Easy to learn, difficult to master

The Enemy Is Closing In

The skies are crowded with enemy aircraft.

The bullets never stop.

Only the most skilled pilots will survive.

Take to the skies, master bullet time, upgrade your fighter, and fight for victory.

The battle begins now.

Will you become an Eagle of World War 2?

data.short_description: Survive overwhelming enemy fire, slow time to weave through impossible bullet patterns, and upgrade your fighter in this explosive WWII-inspired bullet hell shooter. Play solo or with a friend and fight for the top of the global leaderboards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 / Intel I3
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or higher
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 / Intel I5
  • Graphics: GTX 20 or 30 series cards
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard sound
